source.document: AN 01-75F-2, Erection and Maintenance Instructions for Army Models P-38 Series through P-38G-15, F-4 Series, F-5A Series, page 2

conventions.fs_in: fuselage station, inches aft of the gondola nose
conventions.bl_in: butt line, inches to starboard of the ship centreline
conventions.h_frl_in: height above the fuselage reference line, inches
conventions.pixel_provenance: sheet pixel = anchor_px + sign * value * px_per_in, per axis; outline points were read at whole sheet pixels
conventions.outline_method: outer silhouette of the solid (thick) outline strokes: strokes thinner than 3 px (dimension, extension and centre lines) removed by a morphological opening, the exterior and the plan view's open bay flood-filled, the region eroded by 3 px onto the stroke centre and traced; rings are even-odd
conventions.thin_feature_rings: areas where the outline is thinner than its stroke (fin tips seen edge-on, pointed tails, masts, leader stubs), which the erosion cannot represent; a comparison should neither credit nor penalise geometry inside them

evidence: horizontal: extension lines of the overall length 37 ft 9-15/16 in (453.94 in) at x 325 (gondola nose) and x 1431 (rudder trailing edge); the root-chord leading edge extension (119.05 in) falls at x 615, 119.03 in
vertical: fuselage reference line drawn at y 328.1 (the FUS. REF. LINE leader); the thrust line is drawn at y 313.5

vertical scale: canopy top 41.250 in above and gondola bottom 31.010 in below the FRL (front-view callouts) at y 232 and y 402 on this view (2.35 px/in); fin 82.156 in between y 143.5 and y 340.8 (2.40 px/in); 2.375 splits them

side.drawn_in_phantom: The side view omits the wing (only its root section is dashed) and draws the landing gear and propeller in phantom.

evidence: lateral: wingtips at x 213 and x 1735 for the 52 ft 0 in span; ship centreline extension at x 974.5

longitudinal: M.A.C. 84.25 in between extension lines at y 1299.5 and y 1499.3 (2.3715 px/in); the stabiliser leading edge at fuselage station 397.584 falls at y 866.5, which puts fuselage station 0 at y 1809.5; the nose outline's stroke centre is at y 1810

plan.drawn_in_phantom: The plan view draws the propellers as lines only, and no landing gear.

evidence: lateral: wingtip extension lines at x 217.5 and x 1730.8 for the 52 ft 0 in span (2.4252 px/in); the 26 ft 0 in half-span extension marks the centreline at x 973.5
vertical: fuselage reference line drawn at y 2162; canopy top (41.250 in) at y 2064.4 and gondola bottom (31.010 in) at y 2234; 2.375 px/in is shared with the side view

front.drawn_in_phantom: The front view draws the propeller discs, landing gear and drop tanks in phantom (dashed).
